accessibility.title: Worker-uplift telemetry scope decision flow
accessibility.description: The diagram starts with the approved worker-uplift telemetry scope, splits it into required metrics and logs, deferred traces and exemplars, and forbidden profiles and payload telemetry, then shows that metrics and logs go to Grafana Cloud with bounded labels, while the policy also enforces quota guardrails, rollback switches, and privacy limits.

review_notes: The source YAML frontmatter says approval state is approved and publishing is allowed; verify whether that status should be preserved verbatim in the wiki article or simplified for readers.

The canonical infra policy path and issue references (`ramideltoro/nutsnews-infra/...`, `ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker#88`, `ramideltoro/nutsnews-worker#144`) should be checked against current repository naming and issue status before publication.
The article states runtime `0.5.0` exposes specific consumer metrics and events; confirm these names and bounded outcomes are still exact.
Verify the quoted service coverage list, host coverage, queue counts, and label bounds against the current contracts package and telemetry implementation.
The document includes operational credentials and environment variable names; ensure publication policy allows these names to appear in the wiki and that no secret values are exposed.
Check that the future trace-enablement prerequisites, quota ratios, and budget thresholds match the current infra policy and Grafana Cloud limits.
Confirm the protected workflow name `Backend Worker-Uplift Logs Check` and its reported metadata remain accurate.
